_comment: The closure of SGLang code that the engine-path costs depend on, for the release named below. People edit this file; gen_code_paths.py (blis-substrate tools/codepaths) refuses a function that is not in the source and hashes the rest into code_paths.json. host: the work host_admission_*, host_output_token, host_completion and host_step_per_request price. graphs: the launch work host_launch_* and host_replay_graph_per_step price. Add a function here when a cost starts to depend on it; its code then changes the path's CodeID.

host.why: tokenizes a request's prompt: host_admission_per_token, host_admission_per_request
builds the tokenized request sent to the scheduler: host_admission_per_request
receives a step's detokenized outputs per request: host_output_token
the detokenizer process's entry for a step's tokens: host_output_token
incremental detokenization of each emitted token: host_output_token
the scheduler's admission of a request: host_admission_per_request
the scheduler's per-step choice of work: host_step_per_request
the scheduler's per-step, per-request prefill batch formation: host_step_per_request
the scheduler's per-step, per-request handling of decode results: host_step_per_request
the scheduler's per-step, per-request handling of prefill results: host_step_per_request
builds the per-step output sent to the detokenizer: host_output_token
decides a request has finished after a token: host_completion
the teardown of a finished request: host_completion

graphs.why: decides whether a decode step replays a captured graph or runs eagerly
stages a step into a captured graph's buffers before replay: host_replay_graph_per_step
copies a step's inputs into the graph: host_replay_graph_per_step
the eager decode path: host_launch_per_kernel, host_launch_eager_per_layer
the eager prefill path: host_launch_per_kernel, host_launch_eager_per_layer
